note: A case marked hand-written was written from the messages in Docker's source and is replaced by the output of testing/e2e/scripts/record-docker-errors.ts, which marks it recorded.

no-suitable-node.command: docker service ps --no-trunc --format '{{.Error}}' <service created with a constraint no node satisfies>

image-manifest-unknown.command: docker service ps --no-trunc --format '{{.Error}}' <service whose image tag is not in the e2e registry>

image-pull-denied.command: docker service ps --no-trunc --format '{{.Error}}' <service whose image repository does not exist>

container-exit-nonzero.command: docker service ps --no-trunc --format '{{.Error}}' <service whose container exits with code 3>

oom-killed.command: docker service ps --no-trunc --format '{{.Error}}' <service killed for exceeding --limit-memory>

network-external-missing.command: docker stack deploy -c - <stack whose external network does not exist>

volume-in-use.command: docker volume rm <volume a container still mounts>

stack-deploy-unsupported-options.command: docker stack deploy -c - <stack with a build key and no image>

stack-deploy-deprecated-options.command: docker stack deploy -c - <stack with a build key, a container_name and no image>

worker-not-manager.command: docker service ls, run on the worker

daemon-unreachable.command: docker ps with DOCKER_HOST pointing at a closed port

socket-permission-denied.command: docker ps as a user that cannot read the Docker socket
